scripts.check: npm run check --workspace client && npm run check:tauri && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked ruff check server && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked ruff format --check server && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked mypy --config-file server/pyproject.toml server/app && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked pytest --rootdir server server/tests
scripts.check:tauri: cargo fmt --manifest-path client/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo check --manifest-path client/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.dev:server: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir server --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace client && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked ruff format server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace client && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked pytest --rootdir server server/tests
